excerpts.text: Since its [September 19 launch](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/09/apple-debuts-iphone-17/), the new lineup has been defying skeptics who wondered if incremental upgrades could spark real excitement.

Launch demand for the iPhone 17 series was [19% higher](https://telecom.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/devices/iphone-17-launch-sales-outpace-16-debut-pros-most-wanted/124009213) than the iPhone 16 series.

Research firms expect Apple to sell [over 5 million units](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/electronics/iphone-17-launch-sales-outpace-16-debut-pros-most-wanted/articleshow/124005657.cms?from=mdr) in the September quarter, with expectations to reach record sales in the upcoming festive season by growing 28% YoY.
